cand.title: GVA Workshop 2027
cand.organizationName: Genève Aéroport / Travel Inside industry event

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two relevant organizer contacts are verified, but neither is established as a lodging buyer or hotel-contract signatory: Nicolas Simonin, Responsable développement (official workshop dossier), also described as Responsable développement Tourisme/Transport; and Yves-Daniel Viredaz, Chef de service Business development in the June 2026 event report. Simonin is the directly published exhibitor-registration contact; both are credited with organizing earlier workshops. Route the lodging-demand qualification through Simonin and involve Viredaz for broader airport/travel-trade partnership discussions.
findings.futureEdition: 27 May 2027, single-day fifth edition, Restaurant Le Chef at Genève Aéroport, Geneva, Switzerland. Within the requested horizon. TRAVEL INSIDE’s 12 October 2026 announcement explicitly states “le GVA Workshop vivra sa 5e édition le 27 mai 2027 au restaurant Le Chef de l’aéroport de Genève”; this is the activity date, not the publication date. The Swiss Travel Federation’s official industry calendar independently lists “5e GVA Workshop 2027”, “27 mai 2027”, and “by Genève Aéroport”. The airport’s dedicated French/English event page still describes 4 June 2026. Thus 2027 is publicly announced by the established media partner and listed by the federation, but an updated airport-owned 2027 programme was not found. No announced 2028 edition/date was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: YOTEL Geneva Lake is potentially relevant for a small, separately bookable airline-representative/organizer overnight allocation or an ancillary briefing, only if demand is established. Its Founex/La Côte location is an airport-corridor alternative, not a terminal or downtown property. The hotel’s website describes approximately ten minutes by road to the airport, but group transfer arrangements must be confirmed. The 237 rooms, six meeting rooms and approximately 250-theatre ceiling supplied in the brief do not establish room demand or suitability for the complete rotating-table workshop/cocktail layout. Published historical attendance indicates this is not a mega-convention; the barrier is unproven overnight need and an incumbent airport venue, not an evidenced plenary-capacity shortfall. Do not assume banquet scale. Neither a resort pitch nor central-Geneva primary-housing positioning is appropriate.
findings.venueCommitments: Announced 2027 venue: Restaurant Le Chef, Genève Aéroport, Terminal 1 public/landside area before security. City label: Genève (airport); region: Canton of Geneva / Geneva Airport corridor; country: Switzerland. Not Founex, Nyon, La Côte, central Geneva, Lausanne or French Pays de Gex. The airport describes Le Chef as a restaurant with six modular private rooms, not a hotel. The 2027 venue is published, but no signed contract or exclusivity terms are public. This is a meeting/catering venue commitment, not a lodging commitment.
findings.historicalRotation: Four preceding editions are evidenced: 22 June 2023; 6 June 2024; 22 May 2025; 4 June 2026. Each used Restaurant Le Chef at Geneva Airport; the fifth is announced there for 27 May 2027. This establishes repeated annual editions, not a destination-rotation circuit. No historical move to Founex/Nyon/La Côte was identified. Do not project an exact 2028 date from the pattern.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown/unconfirmed. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, named hotel block, negotiated lodging rate, hotel RFP, room-night figure or independently bookable overnight allocation was located for 2027. Therefore there are no verified contracted hotels to enumerate. The official 2026 page says “Confirmez votre inscription à l’aide du formulaire joint à nous retourner par email (nicolas.simonin@gva.ch)”; this is exhibitor registration, not hotel booking. Its dossier defines the CHF 900 excluding-tax exhibitor package as a table, two chairs, roll-up space, two representatives, at most one parking ticket and Wi-Fi; no accommodation inclusion is stated. Absence of housing information is not proof that sourcing is open. Generic airport hotel directories and aggregator featured-hotel advertisements are not edition-specific commitments.
findings.organizationStructure: Genève Aéroport owns/organizes the workshop through its marketing/business-development team. It is an autonomous public establishment owned by the State of Geneva, not an association, PCO, DMC or travel agency. TRAVEL INSIDE is explicitly the media partner; the Swiss Travel Federation calendar is corroborating distribution, not evidence that the federation owns or buys the event. Le Chef is the venue. No external accommodation buyer, PCO or housing agency was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Le Chef is the repeated incumbent meeting/catering venue, including the announced 2027 edition; it is not a competing hotel. No incumbent lodging hotel, contracted room block, sell-out, displacement or overflow evidence was found. For 2024 the organizer offered round-trip CFF tickets to agents/travel managers from Lausanne and beyond: “billets de train offerts par les CFF ... Pour obtenir ce billet aller et retour ... cocher la case correspondante”. This is historical same-day transport support, not proof of 2027 lodging. Inference: airport convenience and a regional afternoon/evening programme may limit overnight conversion; no room-volume estimate is defensible.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Nicolas Simonin at the official workshop address nicolas.simonin@gva.ch; reference 27 May 2027 and acknowledge that Le Chef hosts the workshop. Ask whether any airline representatives, speakers or staff require independently bookable overnight rooms, who pays/books, whether any hotel agreements/exclusivity exist, and whether a hotel partnership or off-site briefing is permitted. Request introductions to the actual lodging decision-makers if demand exists. Involve Yves-Daniel Viredaz for a wider trade/airport relationship. Only then offer a modest demand-led allocation within the hotel’s supplied 20–120-room group guidance, with confirmed transfers and release terms; this is a sales guardrail, not an event demand forecast. Do not hold inventory or price a 237-room buyout on present evidence.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The upcoming edition is 27 May 2027, not the past June 2026 event. Core event space is already announced at Le Chef. No public 2027 hotel procurement route or hotel-exhibitor eligibility was located. The 2026 exhibitor dossier allows one airline per table (or two airlines in an alliance) and is not evidence that a hotel can purchase a stand. Registration via the published contact provides an inquiry path only. Independent lodging might be possible if organizers or airlines confirm it; it is not currently a qualified hotel opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference/strategy: retain as travel-trade relationship development, not as an open future venue RFP. Repeated annual editions support a continuing relationship, but no 2028 date, venue selection process or hotel sourcing cycle is announced. Ask about small ancillary meetings or independent non-local exhibitor stays before proposing accommodation. Pursue the main workshop only if organizers explicitly open venue competition; five published Le Chef editions argue against assuming rotation.
